description: Read the comments on exactly ONE of an item, a ticket or an order (the same one-target shape add_comment takes). Newest first, capped at 50 (`truncated` says the cap was hit). Each comment carries `authorName`, the `text`, `createdAt` with its UTC ISO twin `createdAtIso` (the server does no timezone conversion), and `editedAt` when it was changed after posting. `viaAgent: true` marks a comment an AI agent wrote on that person's behalf, including comments written through this connection; without it the person typed it themselves. The comments are the ones the connected user sees in the app: order comments require being an order participant (requester, assignee or an order manager).

orderId.description: Order id (exactly one target), from list_orders

ticketId.description: Ticket id (exactly one target), from list_tickets

name: list_comments

createdAtIso.description: When it was posted, ISO-8601 UTC timestamp — read THIS one; the server does no timezone conversion

editedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds — absent when never edited

editedAtIso.description: When it was last edited, ISO-8601 UTC timestamp

viaAgent.description: Present and true when an AI agent wrote it on that person's behalf. Absent = they typed it themselves

truncated.description: The 50-comment cap was hit — older comments exist in the app

title: List comments
